title: Axis potential formula
description: Essential: Correctly states the electrostatic potential along the z-axis as Φ(z) = q/(4πε₀√(R²+z²)).

title: Small-z expansion
description: Important: Applies binomial/Taylor expansion to obtain the potential approximation Φ(z) ≈ (q/(4πε₀R))(1 - z²/(2R²)) for z ≪ R.

title: Oscillation force and sign
description: Essential: Derives the axial force F(z) = -(qe/(4πε₀R³))z and identifies q > 0 for restoring harmonic motion.

title: Angular frequency derivation
description: Important: Relates force to SHM to find ω = √(qe/(4πε₀mR³)).

title: Off-axis potential constant β
description: Important: Uses series expansion or Gauss's law to determine β = 1/(16πε₀R³).

title: Off-axis radial force
description: Important: Calculates the radial force on an electron at point B as F(r) = (qe/(8πε₀R³))r.

title: Capacitance calculation
description: Important: Integrates or uses logarithmic potential to find C = 4π²ε₀R / ln(8R/a).

title: Focal length for static charge
description: Essential: Derives focal length f = -E/(e q d β) from kinematics under constant radial force.

title: Focal length for time-varying charge
description: Essential: Derives focal length f = -E/(e C V₀ d β) and identifies effective charge q_eff = C V₀.

title: Sign or unit errors
description: Pitfall: Makes sign mistakes in force direction, oscillation condition, or focal length expression.

title: Misapplied approximation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies the Taylor expansion or small-parameter approximations (z≪R, r≪R).
